How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's exactly what to do when your mattress arrives:
Unboxing (Day 1):
Move the box to your bedroom first — it's heavier than you'd expect with natural materials
Open the box, slide out the mattress, and remove the outer wrap
Place it on your bed frame or foundation (make sure it meets warranty requirements)
Cut the inner vacuum seal — it'll start expanding immediately
You can sleep on it within 30 minutes, though it reaches full expansion in 3-5 hours
Important: Open within 30 days of delivery to ensure proper expansion and keep your warranty valid.
The Break-In Period (First 30-60 Days):
This is the most important part for beginners! The wool and cotton layers will soften and compress naturally over the first 30 to 60 days. The mattress you sleep on tonight won't feel the same in six weeks.
Your body might need time to adjust to proper posture and support — you may even experience a few aches initially as your body adapts. Most people need 60 to 90 days before they fully adjust to a new mattress. That's why there's a 30-day minimum adjustment period before you can return it.
Bottom line: Give it time. Most customers who wait through the break-in period are glad they did!
